title.en: It used to be like that

text.en:
Today you talk about how things were before.
But not now.
I used to drive to work.
There used to be a factory here.
It was so, then it stopped.

I used to. She used to. They used to.
Then say what you did.
This street used to be quieter.
For no, say did not use to.
I did not use to drink coffee.
No d on use.

You will say what you did before.
She used to live upstairs.
I used to work in a warehouse.
And ask: Did you use to live near here?
Did already shows it was before.
So use has no d.
